title: Market view UI contract cleanup after full strategy diagnostics

frontend_computation_evidence: no strategy arithmetic in mvSetupCard / mvCalmCards / mvChartSvg
pass/fail is read from the payload, never derived
source words are a lookup keyed on diagnostics_source, never inferred
mutation M9 (badge invents a word) goes red

backend_restart.reason: monitor/backend/track1_market_view.py changed; the running backend serves the module it imported at startup
backend_restart.note: left to the operator; the scheduler (pid 3000) is a different process and was not touched

defects_found_and_fixed.what: levels_note said 'Strategy levels unavailable' while the sleeve published three price levels
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: note derived from levels published by any source, with armed/unarmed kept apart

defects_found_and_fixed.what: strategy blocks carried no diagnostics_source at the top level
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: every strategy block and setup boundary declares its source; Stress included

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the Stress gate no longer stated the hour it was decided at
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: published from StressParams.setup_time and rendered in the card head

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the absent shift threshold was no longer named on the regime panel
defects_found_and_fixed.evidence: the only mention was a fallback on the Lead note, unreachable because the record always supplies margin_name
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: its own row, carrying the record's threshold_note

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the plot's height came from its content
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: fixed box, empty state in the same box

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the card head height varied with its text
the legend added 40px to a populated tab only
a chip carrying a sentence could not wrap and overflowed at 375px
defects_found_and_fixed.evidence: chip box right edge 385 on a 375 viewport
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: box-sizing: border-box + max-width + wrapping at narrow widths

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the card head overflowed by 20px at every width once the decision hour was added (introduced by this stage)
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: min-width: 0 on head children, ellipsis on the right-hand block

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the 60-day regime run was no longer dimmed
defects_found_and_fixed.evidence: overridden by .regime-strip .regime-run { opacity: 1 }, whose comment covers only height and gap
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: restored at the selector that wins

defects_found_and_fixed.what: Calm rendered inside the market-view band under whichever sleeve was selected
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: its own headed section band, rendered once, hidden when empty

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the page had no way to say the backend could not read something
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: UNAVAILABLE, shown only on an explicit backend error

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the payload-wide levels_note asserted one claim for three sleeves that disagree
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: derived from the sleeves; silent when they differ

self_inflicted_and_caught.what: the derived payload-wide note was inserted into regime() instead of build(), where out['sleeves'] does not exist
self_inflicted_and_caught.caught_by: reading the output instead of trusting the patch

self_inflicted_and_caught.what: the writer test scanned for 'append(' and matched a list method
a new test was inserted between a decorator and its function
the content-spill check reported the tooltip pseudo-element as overflow
self_inflicted_and_caught.evidence: OBSERVE card head 484 -> 462 once .has-tip was removed

claims_deliberately_changed: the strip legend is derived from the states the payload declares, not a fixed four-word list that printed Crisis for a three-state model
a DOM fixture that fed the page pre-5ZZM wording and demanded it not be shown was the stale thing

mutation_harness.method: source-level, subprocess, restored byte-identical; baseline proved green first

green_on_first_run.why: a text slice could not tell inside the div from just after it
calm.error appears twice, so the substring survived the branch being replaced
mis-aimed: removed one of the two rules the fix is made of
both phases present in the fixture, so the fallback could never fire

still_open.what: the Swing sleeve's detector-level regime gate reads day D's own label, which does not exist during its 14:05-15:55 window
evidence: the panel showed Regime Calm for NKD and Regime Unavailable for Swing on the same day from the same detector
NKD reads its label through RegimeLabels(lag_days=1); Swing is handed the raw map and the detector does labels.get(day)
the label map's last entry at 23:34 ET on 2026-08-28 was 2026-08-27
causal_regime_label's own docstring calls reading today's row 'six hours of the future' and guards the OUTER gate only
still_open.why_not_acted_on: runtime trading file, live/backtest divergence, outside this stage's scope and safety constraints
still_open.prior: raised on 2026-08-26 and explicitly left unresolved; today's reading advances it without closing it

still_open.what: the cold market-view build takes ~70s; served stale afterwards with a background refresh
still_open.why_not_acted_on: the frame cannot be shortened - the trend filter is recursive over the full history

still_open.what: one DOM test failed once and did not reproduce across four subsequent runs
still_open.status: recorded as unexplained rather than dismissed
